name: Improve Skills Library
description: Evidence-driven improvement of skill grades, motor success rates, and skill gap coverage.

steps.title: Grade and prioritize
steps.description: Using skill-introspect: run validate-skills to grade every skill. Cross-reference with motor_dispatch telemetry for per-skill success rate and skill-miss counts. Priority = traffic × grade-gap × failure-rate.
steps.accept_criteria: Ranked list. Top priority skill identified with grade, traffic, success rate.

steps.title: Upgrade priority skill
steps.description: Read current SKILL.md and recent motor tool logs. Following SKILL_STANDARD (docs/guides/SKILL_STANDARD.md): add missing layers — procedures first, then error recovery, then examples. Validate grade after edit.
steps.accept_criteria: SKILL.md upgraded to target grade. validate-skills confirms.

steps.title: Test and fill gaps
steps.description: Send 3 test missions exercising upgraded skill. Compare success rate before/after. Check skill-miss telemetry for gaps. If gap found (≥3 misses): using skill-authoring, create new skill.
